routes.title: AI Website & Growth System for Restoration Companies | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: A restoration-specific website and growth system for emergency lead capture, water, fire and mold services, insurance education, local SEO and project proof.
routes.headline: A restoration growth system built around urgency, trust and local response
routes.intro: Restoration companies need fast emergency conversion paths, clear service architecture and proof that supports both homeowners and referral partners.

sections.heading: Emergency lead capture
sections.body: High-intent calls, forms and service paths prioritize water, fire, mold and storm-loss inquiries without burying urgent visitors in generic navigation.

sections.heading: Insurance-aware education
sections.body: Approved educational content can explain process, documentation and next steps without making unsupported coverage or claim promises.

sections.heading: Project proof engine
sections.body: Verified jobs can become local project pages, service proof and case-study inputs while keeping customer facts and outcomes controlled.

routes.title: AI Website & Growth System for Roofing Contractors | Agile Marketing Systems

sections.heading: Repair, replacement and storm intent
sections.body: Different buyer needs receive distinct conversion paths instead of being forced through one generic roofing page.

sections.heading: Inspection and financing workflows
sections.body: Approved offers, scheduling and financing information can be connected to the right calls to action without inventing terms or guarantees.

sections.heading: Project and seasonal content

routes.title: AI Website & Growth System for Foundation Repair | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: A foundation-repair website and growth system for symptom education, inspections, high-consideration leads, financing, local SEO and verified project proof.
routes.headline: Build trust before the homeowner is ready to request an inspection
routes.intro: Foundation repair is a high-consideration sale. The system should help homeowners understand symptoms, solutions and next steps before asking them to convert.

sections.heading: Symptom-led architecture
sections.body: Cracks, settling, bowing walls, water intrusion and related concerns can route visitors into the right educational and service paths.

sections.heading: Inspection-focused conversion
sections.body: Lead forms and calls to action can gather the right context for an inspection without diagnosing conditions the contractor has not verified.

sections.heading: Proof for high-ticket decisions
sections.body: Verified projects, process explanations and approved financing information help reduce uncertainty without invented outcomes or guarantees.

routes.title: AI Website & Growth System for Garage Door Companies | Agile Marketing Systems

routes.headline: Separate emergency repair intent from the replacement buying journey

sections.heading: Repair and emergency demand
sections.body: Broken springs, openers and stuck doors can route directly toward fast contact and scheduling paths.

sections.heading: Replacement education
sections.body: Door styles, materials, insulation and approved product information can support shoppers without making unsupported product claims.

sections.heading: Local service and maintenance
sections.body: Service-area pages, maintenance offers and verified project proof can strengthen local relevance and repeat-customer pathways.

sections.heading: Quote-ready education
